about: Incorporated in 2018, Aelea Commodities Ltd is in the business of cashew processing, which delivers premium cashew products across the globe through general trade, modern retail, institutional supply, D2C, e-commerce, and quick commerce, offering everything from classic cashew kernels to innovative plant- based alternatives.
